scope: Five-equation constrained steady-state root; does not establish dynamic stability or sustained free motion.

release_state.note: Use these only as initial conditions, then release every body DOF. Phase-averaged torque equilibrium permits instantaneous oscillations; examine a second initial wheel phase.

candidate_parameters.parameter_origin: declared experimental model, not a measurement of the news vehicle
candidate_parameters.cabin_condition: open/flooded cabin; only listed solid/sealed components displace water
candidate_parameters.drive_rating_scope: per driven wheel; total budget is per-wheel rating times driven wheel count
candidate_parameters.reference_frame_note: Free body origin is a fixed geometry reference; chassis_com is its physical mass-center offset. Modifications include their mass and parallel-axis inertia.
candidate_parameters.power_sensitivity_note: Power/torque factor is an isolated rating sensitivity at fixed mass, not an engineered engine upgrade.

float_mass_estimate.note: Mass assumption only; no structural certification.

candidate_parameters.initial_clearance_note: 2 cm clearance above calm water for the lowest board or wheel/blade envelope; free entry thereafter.
